theme_strategy: Dark Theme Default. High contrast, luxury corporate aesthetic suitable for international asset holdings.

labels.style: Uppercase, wide tracking for premium feel

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-12, p-16, p-24 for main sections. High breathing room.
layouts.grid: Bento Grid Protocol. Asymmetrical grids for visual tension. No purely symmetrical 'Bootstrap' layouts.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over strict geometrical alignment.

grids.bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Dominant elements span 8 cols, secondary span 4.
grids.features: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 with varying heights

visual enhancers.borders: 1px delicate inner stroke on glass surfaces (border-white/10).
visual enhancers.shadows: Ambient diffuse shadows for depth without muddiness. shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)].
visual enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on solid dark backgrounds to prevent flatness.
visual enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl or 2xl with saturated colors underneath.

motion.hover: Smooth color and opacity transitions. duration-300 ease-out.
motion.scroll: Parallax effects on hero images and skyline backgrounds. Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered fades (opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0).
motion.interactions: Slight scale down on click (scale-95). Glow effects on primary CTA hover.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Use text-shadow over images.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings (ring-1 ring-primary/50) on interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

media.images: High contrast, dark-toned luxury corporate aesthetics. No bright daylight.
media.overlays: Mandatory background overlays on images with text to preserve readability (bg-black/60).

3d libraries.usage: Minimal, optional. Spline for subtle dark architectural elements if needed, but prioritize high-quality photography as per instructions.

component name.strategy: Use Shadcn components heavily customized. Avoid default look. Cards should be flat or glass with subtle borders.

hero_background.recommended_overlay: bg-black/70 or bg-black/80 for text readability

holdings_header_image.recommended_overlay: bg-black/60 to maintain mood and text contrast

about_governance_image.description: Dark, moody imposing building shot from below.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application follows the dark corporate theme (#050505). Incorporate the provided Unsplash URLs in their respective sections, ensuring overlays are strictly followed for maximum legibility of white and gold (#C5A059) text over images. CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Add data-testid to all interactive components.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements. Use modern sharp or pill-shaped buttons with hover animations. Ensure all micro-interactions are present. The UI must look like an elite Delaware C-Corp international asset holdings page.
